name: Galactic Athletes: Blue League
source:
Galactic Athletes Galactic Athletes is a group of leagues where openly gay athletes compete in 20 events. Athletes score points based off their placement in each event. The top 4 athletes in each league move to the Champion’s league while the bottom 4 athletes go to the redemption league. In each event the winner tops last place!
Story Finn is a recent hire for the Thebes Sporting Complex. He will be the Galactic Athletes League’s medic. While he is there to ensure the health and wellness of the league’s athletes, his job hinges on another goal. He must accurately predict who will win and come last in each of the 20 events. Can Finn do it?
translation:
银河运动员联赛
“银河运动员联赛”是一系列由公开出柜的男同性恋运动员在20个项目中同场竞技的联赛体系。选手们根据自己在每个项目中的名次获取积分。各联赛排名前4的选手将晋级冠军联赛，排名垫底的4名选手则将落入复活赛联盟。而在每一项赛事中，第一名都能把最后一名压在身下！

故事背景
芬恩是底比斯体育中心新招入职的员工，担任银河运动员联赛的随队医护人员。虽然他的本职工作是保障联赛选手们的健康与状态，但能不能保住饭碗却取决于另一项任务：他必须准确预测出全部20个项目中谁会夺冠、谁会垫底。芬恩究竟能做到吗？
